title: First band with country girls; Prince Bank and Lawrence Duhé
summary: His first band was a little country group of girls; he recalls hearing and visiting an admired bandleader and Lawrence Duhé in Lafayette.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: 1916. Actually, the other game was the first band I played with. Oh, yeah. The first band I played was a little band with women girls. Oh, is that right? In the country.
Yeah, the band here. Talk about the Prince Bank too. Have you heard about him? Oh, yes. You heard about him? Yes. The first band I played in the yard when I first came in.
I know... He was the man. You heard of him? I knew him. I knew him. I've been to his home.
Lawrence Dewey. Yes, I know him. Out in Lafayette. Yeah. Well, you and Bro went out to see him, did you?
Yes, we went out there almost a year and a half ago. Uh-huh. Now, where were you born?
